# `jouet sessions`

- **Usage:** `jouet sessions [--since <TIME>] [--all]`

Show which agent sessions are working where on this machine

Reads Claude Code's transcripts (~/.claude/projects, or $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) and Codex's rollouts (~/.codex/sessions, or $CODEX_HOME) written within --since (default 24h). For each session it shows the harness, the directory it last worked in, that directory's work tree and checked-out branch, and when its transcript was last written. A session is live when its transcript was written in the last 15 minutes. Only the end of each transcript is read, never what the session said, and nothing is written. Warns about two live sessions in one work tree, which commit each other's uncommitted work, and about a live session whose directory is gone. Lists live sessions; --all also lists idle ones, marking those whose directory is gone. Exits 0 whether or not there are warnings.

## Flags
- **`--since <TIME>`** — Only sessions active since TIME: a duration ago such as 24h or 7d, a date such as 2026-10-01, or RFC 3339 (default 24h)
- **`--all`** — List idle sessions too, not only live ones
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
